collection.title: Alfa Romeo Spider 1995 to 2005 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Alfa Romeo Spider 1995 to 2005 model which requires a 22" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 18" for the passengers side. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm with built in washer jets.
